scope: epistemic pathfinding, missing-corner gap completion, post-saturation expansion
novelty_narrowing: knowledge-graph path reasoning is prior art
abductive graph completion is prior art
automated conjecture generation is prior art

saturation.reason: five retained semantic objects and five open validation fibers; no executable or real-task evidence yet

next_ai.positive: If a future support planner passes the frozen known-answer/hostile worlds and improves a preregistered real path/gap benchmark, test path-corridor context compression under matched evidence and model budgets before considering active routing.
next_ai.null: If target-conditioned support/cut-set planning matches simpler graph or retrieval baselines, keep the theory as an explanatory representation but do not add runtime complexity.
next_ai.refuted: If the planner authorizes unsupported completions, loses blocking history, or misclassifies authority/context mismatches, preserve the failure and retain existing RAKL routing rather than weakening the benchmark.
next_ai.partial_id: If several minimal gap sets remain equally admissible, preserve the set and choose discriminating evidence/actions rather than forcing one missing corner.
next_ai.blocked: If real scientific tasks do not expose ground-truth support/gap structure, use generated known-answer worlds plus historical cutoff cases and report the limitation explicitly.
next_ai.transport: If execution infrastructure is unavailable, record CANNOT_CHECK and do not activate path/gap behavior based on unexecuted tests.
